findings.text: select_lane_model indexes lane["models"][model_key] with no guard, so a lane that declares no models block raises KeyError instead of reaching the shared refusal; today's two callers only pass keys the lane declares, so the path is unreachable now but the guard is missing.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when names the astra picker route, --backend codex --model luna, the sol default, the shared undeclared-model refusal, and per-model candidate/dispatch parity; tests/test_a_lane_model_is_launched_through_its_lane.py:153-317 asserts each and its result is recorded in coordinator-head-gate.log.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/ledger.py, reckon/flight.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py, tests/test_a_lane_model_is_launched_through_its_lane.py and the evidence fragment; every path in the diff is inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read; it states the six-file gate passed 111 at 849893d2, cites verified-gate.log (111 passed in 243.19s, EXIT=0) and negative-control.log (1 failed, EXIT=1).
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against c7ad8433 across five commits (fix, style/lint, evidence fragment, parity test, fragment citation); all changes stay inside the declared scope.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1289, reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:340, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:701, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1534, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2040
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:344-352 returns the lane's own backend for a declared non-default model, and reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:335-342 plus reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1286-1291 both route through flight.select_lane_model, so picker and --model take one path.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: coordinator-base-arm.log (106 passed, EXIT=0) and coordinator-head-gate.log (111 passed, EXIT=0) record the delta the done_when requires; ruff check/format on the five paths was re-verified clean, though the manifest records no ruff log.
SCORE scope_discipline: 17
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every diff path is inside the declared write paths, but commit fff27c18 reformats ~73 unrelated lines of reckon/ledger.py and reckon/flight.py beyond what the goal implies (its own style(lint) commit, policy-permitted, no behaviour change).
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: negative-control.log shows test_picked_astra_launches_through_codex failing with the shared refusal once the ledger fallback is removed, and the same test's independent effort/time_budget literals (tests/test_a_lane_model_is_launched_through_its_lane.py:161-162) fail if select_lane_model stops applying settings.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/flight.py:1617 lane_model_entry was made public under a name that says what it does and reckon/flight.py:1649 select_lane_model follows the module's existing entry-construction idiom, with no plan or ticket identifier in any name or comment.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: select_lane_model (reckon/flight.py:1649) wraps the existing entry owner lane_model_entry rather than re-deriving entry construction, and the ledger fallback (reckon/ledger.py:344) extends the existing resolver; snapshot keeps its own merge by the plan's own directive.
FINDING reckon/flight.py:1667 follow-on: select_lane_model indexes lane["models"][model_key] with no guard, so a lane that declares no models block raises KeyError instead of reaching the shared refusal; today's two callers only pass keys the lane declares, so the path is unreachable now but the guard is missing.
